name: Strange Magic
body:
Strange Magic is a series of systems by Interjection Games that focuses on providing fun, flavorful, and unique options for characters. From advanced musical compositions to drawing out the power of the ether or using exquisitely precise naming to command the universe, there’s no shortage of fun options.

The Assassin

Source: The Assassin: A Modular, Momentum Maneuvers Class

The assassin is death on two legs, using potent techniques to reap the life from their foes. Through intense training, they can learn skills like acupressure, execution, infiltration, and magehunting to use against their targets.

Ethermagic

Source: Strange Magic 1

Ethermagic draws on the wild power of the universe. While its users can only draw upon so much power at once, they can also recharge their powers and get back into action faster than their foes would believe. Each base class offers a very different playstyle, from an adjustable magical blade to pure casting power.

The Ethermancer: An "Eldritch" Reboot

Vendor: Interjection Games
Type: Book
Price: 6.49

A Warlock for the Pathfinder generation!

It can be rather unsettling to learn that our infinite universe is but one of many, a miniscule dot on the roadmap of creation. These universes follow vastly different laws of physics and are prone to annihilating each other if they should ever touch. Though these events do happen, they are quite rare thanks to a weightless and almost completely elastic extrauniversal fluid known as the ether.

There are some puny and insignificant organic creatures who find themselves attuned to this background noise of the multiverse, this infinite source of energy that surrounds them and suffuses the void beyond the edge of everything. Finding they have the ability to communicate with the extrauniversal fluid and to draw from its raw, shapeless energy to do as they will, these ethermancers tend to fall into two camps. Some believe that the universe chose them to carry its greatest gift and use it to protect this tiny speck of creation. Others feel it is a perfect excuse to lord it over everyone. Given humanoid nature, the latter tends to be far more common.

The end result of three months of development, the ethermancer base class takes equal parts Douglas Adams and H. P. Lovecraft to produce an "all day long" spellcaster class with a cosmic flavor. The spiritual successor to the warlock base class of the 3.5 days, the ethermancer seeks to have improved playability by offering the ability to mix and match spell effects to make custom evocations on the fly. Whereas the warlock simply blasted, the ethermancer can ask, "How hard?" Thanks to the advent of a spell point pool, players must choose whether or not to spend more than they will regenerate next turn. Incredibly potent effects are indeed possible, but firing them off without a care in the world will reduce the player to single-target ranged touch attacks in a hurry!

Roleplayers will be pleased to find that their character's personality and character development feeds directly back into the base class. Through the Multiuniversal Philosophy class feature, players decide how their character views their great gift and receives corresponding abilities that feed directly into the character's capstone. Further, the Aberrant Form and Aberrant Physiology class features highlight how the ethermancer's craft slowly twists his body. Is it worth it?

Product Features:

Favored Class options for all common races, as well as most featured races
Innovative spell point system allows for a spellcaster balanced like a martial class with the ability to "burst" like a classic spellcaster
Rules for detecting ethermagic, countering ethermagic, and qualifying for classic arcane spellcaster prestige classes as an ethermancer
140 spells, or "manifestations", in five schools, or "etherhearts"
lesser blast - low cost, moderate damage evocation
greater blast - high cost, high damage evocation
alteration - defensive spells for self only
bestow - defensive and offensive spells for anyone but the caster
genesis - permanent creation of objects from pure energy
13 feats

Limited internal linking and bookmarking

The Maestro Base Class

Vendor: Interjection Games
Type: Book
Price: 4.99

Roll Over, Beethoven!

The prototype of the modern day rockstar, the maestro is a musical genius whose works entertain the masses and make the dull drudgery that is the life of the peasant a little more livable. While usually a man of the people, some maestros are patronized by established power, such as nobles and certain religions seeking new compositions. Still others look to the adventuring profession for the inspiration they need to produce that next great masterpiece. Regardless of their source of income, maestros are often eccentric and almost always possessed of an incredible ego, making their kind an excellent topic for gossip.

The latest in Interjection Games' growing library of base classes, The Maestro Base Class offers up a fairly simple gameplay concept, which is this: what would happen if a bard could compose and perform his own custom performances? Featuring nearly 70 compositions that can be mixed and matched in a number of musical scores, the maestro plays less like a jack-of-all-trades and more like a mystic theurge that just so happens to have music as one of its two sources of power. Wagner, Beethoven, Mozart, Strauss, and more are represented in various Opuses, canned compositions of enormous power that can cause cannonballs to rain down on the battlefield, make an ally a juggernaut temporarily, and even raise the dead.

For those looking to make music and the creative process the defining concepts for their character, this is the class for you.

The product includes

The Maestro Base Class
A spell list that combines the luck-fixing powers of the oracle and the musical mastery of the bard
The Composition Book, containing 28 intros and outros and 40 melodies
Rules for scribing folios of compositions for use by others
6 Feats
13 Opuses
The Fat Lady Sings: 14 Compositions for the Maestro Base Class

Vendor: Interjection Games
Type: Book
Price: 1.25

It's not over until the fat lady sings!

The maestro base class is effectively the bookish bard, an individual who studies music to the point that he can compose his own custom scores from various intros, outros, and melodies in his Composition Book. At release, the class had enough compositions to get by, but, as wizard-like classes go, they can always use more. This modest expansion seeks to add some variety to the maestro's development as a character by providing a selection of compositions with feat requirements.

The maestro primarily works in five schools of magic: conjuration, divination, enchantment, evocation, and illusion. This product features three compositions that require the Spell Focus feat for each of these schools of magic, save enchantment, which has two to balance the fact that the base class already has a composition requiring Spell Focus (enchantment). These compositions offer highly specialized uses, including fate-fixing through rerolls, buffers against hostile enchantments, party-wide mirror image effects, and the conjuration of a fat lady who stuns everything near her. Applied to the base compositions present in the maestro base class, this collection of the situational and the downright powerful will be sure to get the creative juices flowing once more.

Strange Magic Ultimate Bundle - Complete Pathfinder Alternative Magic Collection

Vendor: Interjection Games
Type: Book
Price: 19.99

Who This Appeals To

Perfect for Pathfinder players and GMs who want comprehensive alternative magic systems. Ideal for campaigns seeking fresh magical options beyond standard spellcasting, offering tremendous value for magic-focused groups.

Features
Complete collection of all Strange Magic supplements
Multiple alternative magic systems: ethermagic, composition, truenaming, cartomancy, onmyodo, and herbalism
Dozens of new classes, archetypes, and options
Hundreds of pages of content in one bundle
Significant savings compared to individual purchases
What You'll Experience

Transform your Pathfinder campaign with a wealth of innovative magic systems that go far beyond standard spellcasting. This bundle gives you everything you need to explore unique magical traditions and create truly distinctive spellcasters.

Related Products

Individual Strange Magic titles: Ultimate Ethermagic | Ultimate Composition | Ultimate Truenaming | Ultimate Cartomancy

Master of Forms Expanded: Wood Element - Pathfinder Elemental Shapeshifting Supplement

Vendor: Interjection Games
Type: Book
Price: 1.75

Who This Appeals To

Perfect for Pathfinder players who love shapeshifting mechanics and want to expand their Master of Forms character with nature-themed elemental powers. Ideal for druids, elementalists, and anyone seeking versatile wood-based transformation abilities.

Features
Complete wood element expansion for the Master of Forms base class
New elemental forms drawing on nature and plant-based powers
Unique abilities that blend shapeshifting with wood magic
Seamlessly integrates with existing Master of Forms mechanics
Professional design by Interjection Games
What You'll Experience

Transform into powerful wood-infused forms that give you control over nature itself. This supplement adds depth and versatility to your shapeshifting arsenal, letting you embody the resilience and growth of the wood element in combat and exploration.
